meta.title: Evaluated type of expression varies based on evaluation order
meta.build_notes: npm pyright@1.1.232 (2022-03-23) and pyright@1.1.233 (2022-03-27); release window from the maintainer's comment. A first fix shipped in 1.1.228 and the issue was reopened because hovering only the last e still showed the wrong type (linked Pylance issue microsoft/pylance-release#2324).
meta.notes: Tracking bug of microsoft/pylance-release#2324 ('Type incorrectly inferred as Literal'): the inferred return type of f is (x) -> Literal[0] instead of (x) -> (Unknown | Literal[0]) when the returned e is evaluated before the loop body.

settings_note: The issue names no settings; the session defaults (basic type checking, open files only) apply.

repro.steps: Open main.py and let the server analyze it. Modify the file (press Enter at the end of the file) and hover the e in the return statement right away, before the server re-analyzes the file (the issue: 'hover over the e in the return statement while modifying the file'). After the server settles, hover f (its inferred return type) and the returned e, and compare with a fresh session opened on the same final text.
